terms.grammar: frequēns, “often present”, agreeing with the subject
terms.comment: Traupman’s phrase. Each word is classical (frequēns of a person who is often present), but the phrase is not in Lewis & Short or the loci collections.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 100, checked against the searchable text and the page image (12 November 2026).
